weekend_race.race_comments: Corey Heim has won the Ecosave 250 at the Charlotte Motor Speedway Road Course, his 21st career victory in the NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following trucks dropped to the rear for the reason indicated: No. 2 (Driver Change & Engine Change), No. 22 (Driver Change & Transmission), No. 16 (Unapproved Adjustments), No. 19 (Unapproved Adjustments), No. 38 (Unapproved Adjustments), No. 91 (Unapproved Adjustments), No. 02 (Unapproved Adjustments, No. 45 (Unapproved Adjustments).
